objective: Make state commits work when the state branch tracks no file under .holyagent yet, which fails 45 tests in CI.
scope: CI run https://github.com/davidbasilefilho/holyagent/actions/runs/41544344413 on 02df5d8 fails 45 tests (state-branch, vcs-commit, migrate, process and CLI tests). Error: StateIo ... git add -u -- .holyagent :(exclude).holyagent/local exited 128: error: pathspec '.holyagent' did not match any file(s) known to git; error: pathspec ':(exclude).holyagent/local' did not match any file(s) known to git. Source: stageState in packages/runtime/src/state/tree.ts (added in 386cb22). Locally all tests pass, so the local git likely tolerates the unmatched pathspec where the CI runner's git does not; compare git versions (local `git --version`, CI ubuntu runner) and reproduce, for example by running the failing tests with the CI's git behavior or by a test on a state branch with no tracked .holyagent file.

Fix: only run the tracked-change staging when git tracks a path under .holyagent (for example check git ls-files first, or stage tracked paths by name), so a first state commit works on every supported git version. Keep the staging scope: records, config and migrate's copied paths only, never a stray file.
constraints: Do not touch instruction text or docs.
No version-control writes (no git add on the project, checkout, switch, stash, commit) and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/ of the project; test repos in temp dirs are fine. Report changed paths.
Rebuild dist with bun packages/integrations/claude/build.ts at the end, since the bundled CLI includes tree.ts.
Keep working until done; when done and checked, stop and report. Respond tersely.

criteria.text: Root cause: the report states why CI's git fails and local git does not, with versions

Fix: a state commit on a state branch with no tracked .holyagent file succeeds without depending on git tolerating an unmatched pathspec, with a regression test that fails without the fix on a git that rejects the pathspec, or if no such git is available locally, a test that asserts git is never called with a pathspec that matches nothing
Regressions: stray-file and migrate staging tests still pass
Gates: bun check, bun lint, bun fmt --check and bun test exit 0 after rebuilding dist
